overview: Cross-sectional study of anonymised records of adults examined in the 14 network practices in March 2027, comparing recall intervals with recorded risk and independent risk markers.
population: Adults aged 18 or over with a routine examination in March 2027; 80 records per practice selected by a random number list from the month's examination log (1,120 records).
exposure: Recorded risk category at the examination; independent markers: new fillings or extractions in the previous two years, recorded smoking, diabetes and periodontal pocketing.
procedures: The research dentist extracts the interval, risk field, markers and home postcode district (converted to deprivation quintile) with a piloted form, and double-extracts 10 percent. Records from practices without signed agreements are not extracted until they sign.

outcomes.name: Risk-concordant recall interval
outcomes.measure: Interval within the guideline range for the recorded risk category (low 12 to 24 months, medium 6 to 12, high 3 to 6)
outcomes.why: Directly answers whether recall is risk-based.

outcomes.name: Missing recall interval
outcomes.why: More common in deprived areas (claim c4).

outcomes.name: Risk field quality
outcomes.measure: Blank, or identical to the previous assessment despite new treatment
outcomes.why: Recorded risk may be unreliable (claim c2).

feasibility: About 15 minutes per record: 1,120 records take about 35 of the 48 research days available.
biasMitigation: Random selection from the examination log
Independent risk markers alongside the recorded category
Missing intervals kept as an outcome

biasFlags.label: Unreliable reference standard
biasFlags.note: Recorded risk may be copied forward; markers give a second view.

biasFlags.label: Practices missing agreements
biasFlags.note: Reported explicitly; extraction waits for them.

biasFlags.label: One month only
biasFlags.note: Seasonal variation is unlikely to change interval setting.

parsimony.simplestPath: One month of records, one concordance outcome, network and practice estimates.

theoreticalFramework: None needed; reporting follows STROBE for cross-sectional studies with the RECORD extension.
summary: 1,120 records from 14 practices; one concordance outcome; missing intervals by deprivation.
